notes.title: PATCH 3.4
notes.notes:
Hi AND WELCOME BACK TO ANT QUEEN 3D

New Features


Players can now select what map they want to play with in the sandbox mode
Maps are unlocked with the progression of the campaign
The maps are reactive, they will modify if and object that would block the pathfinding is near the entrance of your colony
New achievements for 1000 and 2000 ants
New achievements for unlocking maps
New level has been added explaining the mushroom chambers
New dialog in the level 16 and 17


Bug Fix

Some players were having issues placing the egg chambers. It should be fix now
The data related the the space each ants was using in the colony has been fix. The numbers are now adding up.
Chambers won't teleport anymore to the nearest pathfinding node. This was placing the new chambers to the outside world in some conditions and so freezing the gameplay
Level  17 time countdown augmented
A few stones that where blocking the pathfinding near water sources have been fix


Thank you again and sorry for the chamber issue
Have a good weekend

notes.title: Update Sept 23
notes.notes:
Patch 23 September 2019


Hi guys and guuurls and welcome back to Ant Queen 3D! 

New Stuff

New amazing mushroom chambers have been added in the game
Mushroom chambers can be added just like egg chambers or replete chambers
Each mushroom chamber can hold between 10 and 20 mushrooms that can be harvested by the ants with cleaning mushroom task activated. When an ant cleans a mushroom, it becomes a food source and then ants that have the feeding task activated will go and use it to feed the queen or the repletes
Mushrooms duplicate over a random time and if the mushroom chamber where they are is saturated, they start the crumble the tunnels nearby and reducing the max room the colony has
After a water flood form a rainfall goes away, for each mushroom chamber you have a bunch of mushrooms will be created
New Ui buttons for the selection of ants. You can now select each ant class and each ant type. They are placed in group of 5 buttons each of one color Brown-red-yellow-green-blue
When the player clicks on an icon it opens a small menu where you can select +5 +15 +1/2 + 2/3 all. A text shows what are you selecting also ex: Selecting Yellow Diggers
Egg UI has also been changed. it has migrated next to the spawning buttons. It's not finish, but it's better than previous circle buttons
SHIFT key now deselects ants or cancels actions such as putting a chamber 
Level 16 has been added. There are 4 grasshoppers that duplicate and you got 30min to kill all the grass hoppers on the map. The map really gets swarmed and the player needs to kill the 4 boss and all the spawned baby grasshoppers
You can now see how many slots a new chamber would have
Chamber visual system has been reversed. If a chamber has 3 spots, circles will appear when they are used


Fixed Bugs

If the player changes the speed during the game, the countdowns like npc spawning, ants losing food, etc will change accordingly and not only when they start back again 
Activated NPC bosses will stay near their starting zone and not walk all over the map
I think i solved the issue where repletes would not get fed
Tunnels won't collapse anymore over a set time. Only mushrooms will create collapsing dirt  blocks
Physiogastry value will not stay blocked at 0 anymore. I completely did a new equation with no possible zeros. Maybe it goes up too fast now. To be tested
Ant counts numbers have been reduce to fit more the circles
Fixed a bug where a replete would die while an ant would be on its way to feed it. The ant carrying the food would get stuck with food in its mouth and stop moving
Fixed a few rock collider issues that would break the pathfinding. If the player would have had the entrance under a rock the rocks will be destroyed
The player can no longer set patrollers while underground
Flood water won't go as high as before and it will start from down go up and go back down again
Grasshoppers of tier 3 a way bigger and more resistant
Level texts have been changed to explain to deselect with Shift key
Added the shift key in the small indicator at the lower part of the screen
As always, typos!!!


To Do
[olist]
Finish Level 16
Add the Control key with scrolling of mouse or + - to increment or reduce the number of ants selected. Ex: if you have 3 workers, 4 diggers and 1 soldier, if you scroll up + hold control you would have 4,5,2 respectively 
Add Level 17 with the tutorial of mushroom chambers
[/olist]

Special thanks to 
ralfaltmann 
Capuzzi09
Lazytribe

Thank you and have a good week!

notes.title: PATCH 2.4

The states of the working tasks the player assignes to each class are saved. Both for the sandbox and the campaign mode. I personally enjoy the feeling it give to the campaign mode since it follows the player from one level to the other.
Water pond status are saved.
There's a new button to set the patrollers on the left side of the screen. It activate the UI for all the patrol zones and after 4 seconds if no patrol unit was set, they all close down.
The game now saves how many Soldiers or Super Soldiers you have assigned to each patrol zone.
Some optimization with the saving and loading, specially about the dirt block inside and outside the colony
New day and night system in the sandbox mode


FIXED STUFF

Missing executable in the previous launch 
Winning condition of level 15. There was an issue with the level being completed at launch since there was no Ai ants on the map...BYE
The outside area dedicated to the dirt mount around the entrance is wider and there's a section that will always stay relatively low to not break the pathfinding grid
You can now highlight all the new queens with the center low UI buttons

notes.title: PATCH 2.2
notes.notes:
Hi,  and welcome to Ant Queen 3D

I have been away for some time and this is a preview of the upcoming patch
The patch will go live on the 3 of august

There will be a master reset, If you don't want the new features and keep your game progress you can simply not update the game.

NEW STUFF
The underground colony can be dug on many levels. This new feature has a lot of impact in the game play and it required a lot of changes regarding the code, the path finding and the saving of the players data. it’s looks really good, but on the down side a full reset of the game is required sorry.
New achievements for unlocking the Colors of ants you can produce
Red ants and yellow ants each have one stat boosted. Respectively attack and speed. Blue spec has more health and stores more food. Green ant have a minor boost on all stats
The nuptial flight is the action that unlocks the ant Colors. 5 - 15 - 30 - 50.
Patrol zones can have soldiers and/or super soldiers assigned. In the situation that you have 3 Soldiers and you assigned 3 Soldiers to a singe patrol zone, if you chose to assign a soldier to an other patrol zone, automatically a soldier is removed from the first patrol zone and added to the new chosen zone. 
Units won't try to get the same food part, dirt block or egg
New alert button appear when you are under attack. Clicking it will teleport you to the area
Physiogastey System for the egg spawning. This was requested from enough players to be implemented in the game. In nature, a queen cannot simply put eggs all the time, she basically build reserves of «eggs» that she will later spawn. So far, the queen will slowly build a physiogastry level and will give player an X number of ants she can spawn. If you have more than 0 as the physiogastry level, you can click on the spawn unit icons. The new egg will be added in a queue and after some time, the egg will be spawn.
UI bar showing the physiogastry value
The status of the food source the player set iare saved and loaded. 
The soldiers or super soldiers you assign to the patrol zones are saved and loaded
Queen spawning tooltip adjusted


FIXED STUFF

The outside mount created from the player digging was breaking the interior from the exterior. It should be fixed. To be confirmed.
The queen mouth position was always a stop behind in her last position
Hungry units were not taking food in some situations
The NPC spawning system has been changed again!!
The water levels have been adjusted to new possible digging height
The raining events are more random and spaced appart
Colliders of food zones have been adjusted to no block the hovering events of the mouse
There is a number of not dug dirt block that blocks the player from digging more. This values has been augmented allowing the player to dig more
When the player digs, less dirt blocks are created
You can once again rotate the camera with the arrows and the right mouse
Switching views will close down the digging assistant, unless your at level 2 in the campaign
There was a small background music even if you settled to the volume to zero. 
The center button for selection shows the total number of ants you control


WORK IN PROGRESS

A lot of Ai work has been done. Some ants where standing still after a few events.
Ai enemy colony gameplay
The animator will be ready to work mid of August and the new skin will be added in during the month 
The animator will also work on the physiogastry of the Queen 


Once more, thank you for helping me out.
Cheers

notes.title: Patch 1.99
notes.notes:
Hi,  and welcome to Ant Queen 3D

NEW STUFF

Soundtrack audio and game sounds now each have their own slider
Digging has a cooldown of one second.
Saving got fix. The issue was that player could dig to infinity. The player could be a level 4 with 6 ants and dig a colony the size of the entire map. Since digging creates blocks to be excavated, you could have to save 10000 block that requires to save x.y.z position for each. For now the easy fix is you cannot dig further your colony if you have more than 200 dirt blocks to excavate.
The player can no longer in level 3-4-5
If your colony is too close to a spider web, the web is destroyed. And if there was an NPC that would have been triggered from walking in it, the NPC is also destroyed. The level is then adjusted
Main menu says whats version your are playing on


FIXED STUFF

Digging assistant stops getting stuck in red phase
Nurser don't have by default the rescue action activated, Soldiers do.
The NPC spawner only counts adult ants
The end game sparkles are no longer active during a level
Some level texts have been changed


WORK IN PROGRESS

Level 16 is under construction
Ai colony gameplay


Once more, thank you for helping me out.
Cheers

notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.notes:
Hi,  and welcome to Ant Queen 3D

NEW STUFF

Players were having a hard time to find what ants or aphids were under attack. So, I added a visiual indicator that starts from the colony entrance and goes in the direction of the attack point. It's a trail of sparkling red pheromones.
Almost each level in the campaign has a few dialogs. Now the camera rotate towards what unit that is speaking and that unit also is highlighted. If for any reason there are no nursers or no workers, AKA the player is really bad, the dialogs will still be happening, but for logic reasons there are no more highlights.
When the player finishes a level in the campaign, at the end he has a two new buttons. Continue to the next level or go back to the selection.


FIXED STUFF

Highlighting square was acting weird. The green square won't stay active when you release the mouse button.
Fixed a few typos. How can I be that bad of a writer!?...
If any level requires some ants, only adult ants are being taken in consideration
The queen cannot be unselected in the first two levels
Optimized saving. Should be a little faster. It still needs works, but it's better
There was a bug with levels showing a timer countdown and level objective
Tunnels will only start collapsing once the player reaches 45 ants.
Once you set volume, mouse or zoom settings. It will automatically preset at each level


WORK IN PROGRESS

Fix level 15 and the Ai colony
Back propagation buttons issue 
Add new UI buttons


Once more, thank you for helping me out.
Cheers

notes.title: PATCH 1.8
notes.notes:
Hi,  and welcome to Ant Queen 3D

FIXED STUFF


Rotating the camera with the mouse won't deselect units anymore. Deselecting a unit only happens if you press the right mouse button with out holding it.
You can Rotate ant Classes to assign their tasks left or right. You don't need anymore to rotate the whole 6 classes to comeback to a specific class. Thanks Lazytribe ;-P
Dirt on the ground won't prevent anymore adding a chamber. I thought it would be logic to demand the player to excavate a room to be allowed to add a new chamber, but players have the impression it's a bug.
Deactivated a lot of unnecessary UI components int the first two levels.
Fixed a bug where you could switch views with out having an underground colony.
Zooming control and mouse sensitivity settings have more impact.

WORK IN PROGRESS

Something like flashing red a series of pheromones from the colony in the direction of an NPC. I will try this feature in next patch


Once more, thank you for helping me out.
Cheers

notes.title: PATCH 1.5
notes.notes:
Hi,  and welcome to Ant Queen 3D

NEW STUFF

  New story line has been added in the game. A testers pointed out that people who don’t know ants might not understand what each class is good at or not. There is already a level system to guide the player, but it was lacking context. On top of explaining more in detail what each class can do, the story line has a few references that alíviate the gameplay.
 There was a row of buttons that would be use to select groups of class for each color. In reality this was useless. I transformed this buttons in counterd for the eggs that are developing
 Eggs now have a visual countdown image on top of them. This shows the player how long it will take for an egg to mature
 When ever an egg is ready to be nursed all nursers use to go and take care of it. Now only one single nurser will be assign one egg
 A few buttons where visible too early in the campaign. The progressively become unlock as needed by the campaign 
 Tier 1 spiders have been again nerfed


TO DO

Add the NPCS
Fix Lv 15
Add a new Level


NOTE: You need to delete previous chambers, save your game and restart. Long story short, chambers didn't have a maximum holding capacity in the past so no dada was saved.

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
Hi, Welcome  and now to Ant Queen 3D

NEW STUFF

 A new egg chamber system have been added 
 Each egg chamber needs to be in a different room and also at a distance from other egg chambers
 So far each chamber holds 5 eggs at maximum
 Mushrooms are not infecting all the colony, but only a certain zone 
 A patch of mushrooms appears after a rain fall and if not dealt with, they start spreading
 If mushrooms are not cleaned away, the colony looses food stocks
 Spiders are now dangerous and they take multiple ants to kill, including soldiers
 Beetles are now tougher and they deal less damage
 The sandbox scenario system is fully operational and it gives a good idea of what it can be
New controls that allow full 3D motion... or almost
Removed some UI components that were removing the nature aspect of the game
New Achievements have been added
 Bugs, bla bla bla Fixed! By Felicia!


TO DO


 Add the new Queen Nuptial Flight. This will be the ultimate goal of the game. It's closing down the full cycle of an ants colony's life.  A nuptial flight is  when winged ant queens, from many colonies, fly out of their colony, reproduce and start a new colony.
A few challenges of the Sandbox mode will be to release 10 queens at start, what will take for ever, and go on like this to 20 - 34 - 85 - etc.

 Finish level 13 and add a new level
 Add new skins to the ants
 Add more Scenarios
 Add new achievements
 Create the AI colony of ants
 Add more NPC in the game :

 Flies
 Caterpillars
 Centipedes
 Termites




Of course I can do all of this! 
First, I will hit level 13 and then add the Nuptial Flight System.
Next week I will work towards adding an other level, new scenarios and add a new NPC.

And if you read this far, you are better than me cause I just never read any logs. My amazing team of testers are strongly suggesting I need to keep up with making a log so to make everyone happy, here it is!
